svg.title: The wiring defect is fixed and the remaining wall is measured
svg.desc: The index-of-coincidence rank remains two-hundred-twenty-three-thousand one-hundred-eighteen of four-hundred-fifty-six-thousand nine-hundred-seventy-six. The repaired climb reaches twenty-five of seventy-two letters and five of ten plugs, then fails the final gate. A real Bombe stop must replace oracle seed plugs.

g.text: AFTER THE DENSE TABLE AND OBJECTIVE REPAIR
1 · THE FIRST-LEVEL SIEVE IS STILL BLIND
2 · THE REPAIRED CLIMB IS BETTER, NOT COMPLETE
25 / 72 letters · 5 / 10 plugs · final gate: NO BREAK
3 · REPLACE THE ORACLE WITH A REAL STOP
four correct seed plugs flip the median margin
the target still needs the Bombe to supply them honestly
No more corpus-wiring story. No confidence number. No break.
